name: sprint33_qhour_open_spy_v7
hypothesis: Quarter-hour boundary VWAP-slicing algo flow (arXiv 2607.09426) predicts 15m drift on SPY RTH bars. Identical frozen params to sprint15/24/25/27 (6 prior attempts, all n=0 on the same data defect, not a null result).
power_argument: SPY 15m return stdev ~15bp; SE at n=300 ~0.87bp, min detectable edge at t=2 ~1.7bp, well below the ~26bp T2 cost floor (C0/C1 calibration). 26 boundary bars/day RTH x cap8/day x ~63 validation days = up to 504 possible entries, clears the 300 floor.
